scope: Read-only review of interim helper and unit source only. No source edit, test execution, native/browser measurement, host/CSS final review or release acceptance.
result: No lifecycle blocker found; one equality-guard correction proposed before final review.
positiveFindings: Each seat observes its parent arena, independently fits current internal geometry and returns only positive finite width. It does not mutate canvas bitmap dimensions, art or game state.
RO callback uses contentRect; only explicit refresh reads client dimensions. Planned zero-padding parent makes client dimensions a suitable bounded fallback.
Cached pagehide suspends and increments generation; pageshow reconnects and refreshes; old observer closures are fenced by generation. Terminal dispose is idempotent and unregisters owned listeners.
Zero boxes apply a zero CSS footprint and return undefined width; a positive notification restores sizing. This makes any renderer fallback invisible pending positive fit.

Existing units exercise independent seats, width/height geometry, invalid boxes, duplicate integer deliveries, zero recovery, old callbacks across BFCache/terminal disposal and no-observer refresh. They have not been rerun by this reviewer.

finding.detail: The equality guard compares CSSStyleDeclaration serialized strings with full JS floating-point decimal strings. A browser-normalized fractional value can differ from the assigned spelling, unlike the plain style object in the fixture, permitting repeated writes for equal fractional deliveries. This is source/API review, not a native reproduction in this lane.
finding.suggestion: Cache numeric applied width/height and an initialized state, or keep normalized post-assignment representations; verify with a CSS-like style setter that normalizes a repeated fractional measurement. Avoid changing the fitted ratio merely to satisfy string comparison.
